name: transition-brush-wipe
title: Brush Wipe
description: Năm vệt cọ dày lần lượt quét ngang từ trái sang, chồng lên nhau tô lộ cảnh mới.

moworks.author: takayu

options.each: s each band's edge crosses the frame (0.36)
options.slant: px the top edge rises toward the lead (30)
options.ease: power2.out (cubic); the site's demo eases in-out

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-brush, written here): 5 bands (each ~1/4 of frame height at a 1/5 pitch, so they overlap ~5 %), leading edge vertical, top edge slanting up ~6 px; band i starts at i x 60 ms and its leading edge runs from just left of the frame to past the right edge over 360 ms easeOutCubic (demo ease-in-out); together they mask in the incoming scene; 600 ms total. Straight polygon edges in the demo; ragged dry-brush ends are optional. Params: strokes (5) · stagger (60 ms) · duration mỗi vệt (0.36 s).
